services.title: Tree Removal
services.desc: Safe felling of dead, diseased or unwanted trees. We dismantle large specimens section by section and remove all debris from your property.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Reduce height and spread, improve light penetration and remove dead wood. Keeps trees healthy and your garden unshaded.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Fallen trees, hanging branches and split limbs cleared fast. We work within 24 hours of urgent calls and make your property safe immediately.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Removal
services.desc: Neat, professional hedge maintenance or complete removal. Perfect for boundary work, privacy and preventing root damage to drains.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Grind out old stumps below ground level. Leaves a clear garden and prevents regrowth — far neater than digging out roots by hand.

services.title: Tree Planting & Aftercare
services.desc: Supply and plant native species suited to Nottinghamshire soil and climate. Includes staking, mulching and 12-month establishment care.

about_pullquote: We climb the tree, not the bill. Fair pricing, honest advice.
about_para_1: Tree Toppers started in 2004 when founder Mark decided there had to be a better way than the usual cowboys charging a fortune for twenty minutes' work. Two decades later, we've felled over 450 trees and pruned countless more across Nottinghamshire. We're NPTC qualified, fully insured for public liability and professional indemnity, and members of the Arboricultural Association.
about_para_2: Customers come back to us because we don't oversell the work. If a tree doesn't need removing, we'll tell you. If a prune will do, we prune. We leave every garden cleaner than we found it — chipped waste removed, branches tidied, no mess left behind. Many of our repeat clients have been with us for over a decade.
reviews_heading: What Nottinghamshire Homeowners Say About Tree Toppers

reviews.text: Had a massive oak that was threatening the garage. Mark came out, gave us an honest quote — lower than the other two we'd got — and the job was done within the week. Brilliant crew, very tidy, and fair on the price. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Storm brought down a big branch across our driveway. Called Tree Toppers on a Saturday afternoon and they were round the next morning. Had it cleared and chipped before breakfast. Exactly what you need in an emergency.
reviews.author: Linda M.

reviews.text: Used them for hedge trimming and tree pruning. The lads were professional, no fuss, and left the garden immaculate. They came back this year without being asked and we've had them on an annual contract since. Great value.
reviews.author: Robert T.
